turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, how can I help you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My email confirmation says that I ordered 2 items, but I only ordered 1.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Oh no, let me fix that for you! Can I get your full name to pull up your account?

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Account has been pulled up for Joseph Banter.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks! Can I have your account ID and order ID to look up your order?

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Querying the system for an answer ...

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Got it. Unfortunately there is an error on our end. Do you know the shipping status of your order?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: It looks like we'll have to process your refund as a return after your receive the item. I am so sorry for this inconvenience!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Ok. So I guess I'll get back to you after I receive it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's right, just contact customer service after you've received your order.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Of course, and I'm sorry again for the inconvenience. Is there anything else I can do for you?
